facts.claim: The mercurial barometer shows its maximum height during the hot weather months and reaches 26° 60' and its minimum during the monsoon, when it falls to 26° 15'.
facts.quote: The mercurial barometer shows its maximum height during the hot weather months and reaches 26° 60' and its minimum during the monsoon, when it falls to 26° 15'.

facts.claim: During the cold months, from October to January inclusive, the daily average variation ranges over 24° Fahrenheit between the extremes, giving a daily mean of 65°.
facts.quote: During the cold months, from October to January inclusive, the daily average variation ranges over 24° Fahrenheit between the extremes, giving a daily mean of 65°;

facts.claim: During the monsoon, from June to September, the temperature is most equable, moving between the extremes 60° and 75° which leave only a daily variation of 15° and a daily mean of temperature of 65° for these months.
facts.quote: during the monsoon, from June to September, the temperature is most equable, moving between the extremes 60° and 75° which leave only a daily variation of 15° and a daily mean of temperature of 65° for these months.
